text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall: elevated packet loss detected on egress via CarrierX in us-west-2. Loss ~11-15% observed across multiple POPs. Auto-escalation to severity-2. Incident channel created.

mike_sre: saw the alert, on it. Which customer flows are hitting us-west-2 right now?

emma_neteng: metrics show loss on the primary transit link towards CarrierX ASN 64501. BGP keepalives are fine, but data plane is dropping. I'm pulling flowlogs.

carrierx-alert-bot: CarrierX NOC: We are investigating a degraded fabric in west region impacting multiple peers. Working on mitigation. Ticket CX-42321.

mike_sre: ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) confirm impact scope 2) shift critical traffic to alternate transit (TransitY) via BGP community 3) open customer comms. Emma, can you validate TransitY capacity?

emma_neteng: TransitY has spare capacity on our edges in SFO and PDX. I can push an additional more-specific /24 advertisement out to prefer TransitY for affected prefixes. Will prepare BGP snippet.

mike_sre: do it. Add a short TTL and watch for propagation. Post snippet here before applying.

emma_neteng: Applying now. Snippet: ```
# announce more-specifics for service prefixes to prefer TransitY
neighbor 203.0.113.10 remote-as 64400
route-map TO-TRANSITY permit 10
 set community 64400:400
set local-preference 200
! apply to affected prefixes
```

raj_sre: taking on-call lead for the next 25m while Mike coordinates customer comms. Raj signing in.

mike_sre: thanks Raj — handoff noted. Sophia, can you draft a short customer notice? Need to call out degraded requests and any impacted SLAs.

sophia_support: drafting: "We are experiencing increased request timeouts for services routing via our us-west-2 transit. Our engineers are actively rerouting traffic and we expect reduced errors within the next 15-30 minutes. We will update when mitigation completes." Anything else?

david_product: include affected services list: embeddings ingest, realtime chat API for west-region customers, and batch ingestion for partner integrations. Also note we are prioritizing low-latency routes first.

mike_sre: include a short workaround: customers can pin to eu-west or us-east models if latency critical. We'll post in status.redwood.ai.

emma_neteng: TransitY announced more-specifics, seeing AS path shift for ~80% of affected prefixes already. Loss metrics dropping to 3-6% on edges that moved. Still seeing spikes on CarrierX-bound edges.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1781, severity: 2, assigned: raj_sre, responders: emma_neteng, mike_sre.

raj_sre: monitoring BGP updates and traffic. Running quick pings to carrier edge: ```
# quick check
ping -c 10 198.51.100.1
# results: 10 packets transmitted, 1 received, 90% packet loss (on carrier-facing hop)
```

emma_neteng: thanks — that's at the carrier-facing hop. CarrierX NOC just tweeted that they see partial fabric instability and are applying local mitigations; timeline unknown.

mike_sre: ok, plan B if CarrierX doesn't stabilize in 20m: withdraw peer and force longer-term shift to TransitY + throttle less-critical flows. Prep config for that and mark change window.

sophia_support: posted initial notice to status page and notified top 12 customers via DM. Customer A acknowledged and asked for ETA.

david_product: escalate to account execs for any enterprise customers with Dedicated capacity — verify whether their dedicated routes are impacted or shielded.

raj_sre: confirmed Dedicated pools using private peering to CarrierX might still see impact. Emma, can you run a quick check of private peering circuits?

emma_neteng: checking private peering stats... looks like two private sessions showing 5-7% packet loss on data plane paths; control plane stable. I opened a ticket with CarrierX NOC referencing our private peer IDs.

carrierx-alert-bot: Update from CarrierX NOC: we have identified an overloaded fabric card in west1 causing packet drops for select peers. We are diverting traffic internally. Estimated mitigation ETA: 30-45 minutes.

mike_sre: good to have ETA. Raj, keep monitoring and coordinate with CarrierX. If loss drops under 2% across all edges, we'll start closing mitigation steps.

raj_sre: will do. Starting continuous perf collection and will update every 5m. Next update in ~5m.

oncall-bot: Note: if incident extends beyond 2 hours, incident will auto-escalate to Sev1.

sophia_support: updating customers with the new ETA and note on private peering too.

mike_sre: thanks everyone. After stabilization we'll run a targeted post-incident review focusing on transit diversity for us-west-2 and routing preferences. Marking action items: emma -> formalize permanent route preference plan; raj -> collect RIB+flowlogs; sophia -> compile impacted customer list; mike -> postmortem owner.

emma_neteng: logged action items and starting draft doc.

raj_sre: 5m update: packet loss trending down on edges that moved to TransitY, CarrierX-bound edges still fluctuating but improving (6% -> 3%).

mike_sre: great. continue. If CarrierX reaches under 2% across all edges, we'll start draining more-specific announcements.

(oncall handoff and commander note): raj_sre is incident lead, mike_sre secondary.

sophia_support: customers updated, majority ok with ETA. A few want hourly updates.

mike_sre: thank you. Closing interim note. Will post closure when metrics stable for 30m and customer impact summarized. :white_check_mark:
